```yaml
name: Rust Web Build

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["rust-windows.yml"]
    types:
      - completed

jobs:
  build-wasm:
    if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust toolchain for WebAssembly
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          target: wasm32-unknown-unknown
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Enable Rust problem matchers
        uses: r7kamura/rust-problem-matchers@v1.1.0

      - name: Download native build artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: native-build
          path: ./native

      - name: Build WebAssembly target
        run: |
          cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
          mkdir -p ./wasm
          cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/*.wasm ./wasm/

      - name: Upload WebAssembly artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: wasm-build
          path: ./wasm
```
